walkthroughs.h2: How to set the right weight
walkthroughs.body_html: For strength, lift 70-85% of 1RM for low reps (4-8). For muscular endurance, lift 50-60% of 1RM for high reps (15-20). For power, lift 75-85% of 1RM, performed explosively for low reps.
A swimmer's 1RM bench press = 80 kg. To train muscular endurance at 50%: 0.5 × 80 = 40 kg. To train strength at 80%: 0.8 × 80 = 64 kg. Track 1RM monthly to apply progression.

Athletes differ in age, fitness, sport, injury history and lifestyle. A programme for a 14-year-old novice differs from one for a 25-year-old elite. Individual differences ensures plans match the person and reduce injury risk.
